compliant_spring_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Single-piece print-in-place compliant claw clips. Sliced at a high 240C melting temperature in dense 95A TPU. Enforces a strict 45-degree rotation offset on the build plate grid with 0% print fan cooling. This forces the toolhead to weave diagonal cross-hatched paths directly over the central living chevron spring, maximizing polymer chain alignment to prevent hairline shear fractures under constant hair torsion.

compliant_spring_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: Alternative high-flex Polypropylene (PP) clip runs. Hardcodes an 8mm outer solid brim and 0% cooling fans during the print run to eliminate plate warping. Invokes our specialized rapid thermal-quenching end G-code to freeze the plastic into a highly flexible, amorphous state, preventing brittle crystallization along the jaw folds.
